resources.string: Counts the reels and shorts you scroll and the time you spend in Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Snapchat and other short-video apps, and shows a small counter on top of those apps. For other apps only the app name is used, to know when you leave a social app. Counts stay on this phone and are never uploaded.
Stops children from uninstalling Abhi Utility. Parents turn it off in Abhi Utility → App Lock with the App Lock or Diary password.
